name: Smart Kitchen Assistant
tagline: Snap your ingredients or a meal - get recipes and step-by-step cooking help.
description: Smart Kitchen Assistant is your AI cooking companion. Chat with or without images: photograph the ingredients you have and get dish suggestions you can make right now, or photograph a finished meal and learn exactly how to cook it with a full ingredient list and step-by-step instructions. Every conversation (including photos) is saved so you can return to it from the history sidebar, and stored photos can be cleared at any time.
_comment_bundled_executas: Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one first, then substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory - the file on disk is never mutated) and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js so the UI bundle can read the same ids.
